messages:
jess: Quick ping 5m PR to add an SDK example for streaming responses. Would appreciate a quick review if someone on docs rotation has a minute: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/501
omar: I can take it in ~20m. Is it safe to merge in the 16:00 merge window or should we queue?
priya: Heads-up this file is linked from the quickstart, so I'd like to sanity-check the anchor. If the preview breaks we should hold until tomorrow AM.
sam: @jess can you paste the exact snippet here so I can glance now? Faster than opening the PR.
jess: heres the snippet I added:

```js
await client.init();
const s = client.stream('/v1/generate', { model: 'redwood-x1' });
for await (const part of s) {
  process.stdout.write(part.delta);
}
```

no deps, plain async iterator
omar: looks straightforward. tiny suggestion: mention error handling for stream early close (a second tiny snippet) but not required for this PR.
jess: added a one-line note about try/catch around the loop.
ci-bot: build/docs-preview 0running preview for PR #501
doc-preview-bot: preview URL: https://deploy-preview-501--docs.redwood.ai
priya: preview shows the new example but the quickstart link to `/guides/quickstart#streaming-example` 404s.
omar: I see that too. The slug probably changed in the migration branch to `streaming-api-beta`.
sam: I'd avoid renaming headings in this change. Simpler: update the quickstart link to the existing section slug so the preview passes.
jess: agree, keep this minimal. Ill update the link in the PR.
ci-bot: build/docs-preview 0FAIL
ci-bot: error: broken link  /guides/quickstart#streaming-example not found
sam: pushing a tiny commit to replace the anchor with `#streaming-api-beta` (one-line fix).
ci-bot: build/docs-preview 0running preview again (commit a7c9f4)
doc-preview-bot: preview URL: https://deploy-preview-501--docs.redwood.ai
priya: preview rendering looks good now, snippet appears and link resolves.
omar: approved the PR with a short inline comment about adding a brief error-handling note later.
jess: thank you! planning to merge during the 16:00 window.
sam: will monitor the merge window in case anything else trips the preview.
priya: side note for rotation: Thu-Fri afternoon is sparsely covered — can we add a backup on the docs rotation or a `docs-backup` tag in the handbook so small PRs like this can get stamped quickly?
omar: good idea. Ill create a small issue to propose a backup policy.
jess: merged  everything looks green. thanks everyone :party_parrot:
